news.title: SUFFOC at the Compass Sport Final
news.text: 26 members of SUFFOC travelled down to East Sussex for the 2026 Compass Sport Trophy final. This is only the fifth time SUFFOC have qualified for the final, so it is an honour to be invited to compete as a club at this prestigious event. The event was hosted by Mole Valley Orienteering Club at Pippingford Park near Uckfield. There was a well organised parking area adjacent to the arena and we were able to erect the club tent close to the run-in. The weather was mostly kind to us, only having one or two showers right at the end of the day, and we did well to come 9th in the Compass Sport Trophy competition ahead of both NOR and LOG who had beaten us in the heat at Brandon Country Park back in February. Details of our scorers are shown here, but even if some of us weren’t one of the top 13 scorers to make our total of 1128 points, we may have pushed other club scores down. So it was fantastic to have so many SUFFOC competitors. Not forgetting Skye Hodkinson who won the Golden String trophy. Well done all! Full results for the event are available on the Mole Valley website. https://mvoc.org/2026/10/15/results-for-the-compasssport-final-at-pippingford-park/ Photos courtesy of Robert and Edward Lines.

news.title: SUFFOC 2026 AGM
news.text: AGMs are often things folk avoid: too boring or I don’t want to be forced into a role. The SUFFOC AGM on Saturday 3rd October can counter both those aspects. We’ve got a fun 45minute score event in Christchurch Park to tackle before the AGM and we promise not to force you into anything. Having said that, there are some known big changes coming up in the Committee. The Wilkinsons are moving and so Sally is stepping down as Fixtures Secretary – a vital role we need someone to fill getting permissions and allocating roles for our events. Sally is happy to talk over what is involved and can act as on-line mentor as you learn the job. Simon Hooton is stepping down as chair after 5 years and so someone to steer things is needed. Many tasks are delegated out to folk tackling different roles – Treasurer, Secretary, Mapping etc. – and so much of the chair’s function is to make meetings and the general progress go smoothly. Again, advice and help will be available to the new post holder. The Club is keen to try and grow in numbers and so more publicity and developing links with others is a priority along with refreshing the website. Gareth Radcliffe and Sarah Mansel are planning a series of ‘Street Os’ during the Autumn: midweek score events starting and ending near a pub and so with the chance of more social engagement. The Club will also be in the Compass Sport Trophy Final on 18th October so there is much to engage with – and some fresh faces joining the Committee will make that so much easier. We hope to see you in Christchurch Park – details on the website and RaceSignUp. If you can’t be there but might be willing to pick up a role or just sit in on some Committee meetings (held on Zoom in an evening) to see what its about then do get in touch with any of the Committee members for an informal chat.

news.title: Yvette Baker Trophy Qualifier
news.text:
Suffolk Orienteering Club attended the Yvette Baker Qualifier at Weald Park, Brentwood (HAVOC) on Sunday 8th March 2026.

The courses were well planned and the area is an interesting place to orienteer.

Our juniors competed excellently and came 2nd to Norfolk Orienteering Club by one point. 

The results were:

Ethan Radcliffe: 100 (Green - Boys)

Aaron Radcliffe: 100 (Light Green - Boys)

Reuben Constable-Simmonds: 100 (Yellow - Boys)

George Wightman: 99 (Green - Boys)

Emily Wightman: 98 (Orange - Girls)

news.title: British Orienteering Championships
news.text:

Their results were:

M45L Gareth Radcliffe 14th

Women’s Short: SUFFOC Skedaddlers Louise Walker, Bronwen Mansel Sarah Mansel 10th

news.title: Warm Weather Winter Orienteering and Quarantine
news.text:
In the last few years we have travelled abroad in February for our orienteering fix.  It has the benefit of orienteering in different terrain whilst also, usually, being a bit warmer than the UK.

In 2026 we travelled to Southern Spain for the Malaga Orienteering Sprint Camp. (MOSC)

This has previously been held in 2020 and 2024.  We went in 2024 and loved it so much that we were keen to do it again.

This year the Monday to Friday consisted of 5 sprint training races around various old villages to the north of Malaga plus Torremolinos.  After an early run there was time to do some sightseeing around the town and surrounding countryside.  What’s not to like?

The sprint courses were excellent and tested different sprint techniques including swift decision making and turning around in the old towns with long route choice legs across the grain of the town road systems.

news.title: SUFFOC qualify for the Compass Sport Trophy Final 2026
news.text:
At the local qualifying heat of the Compass Sport Trophy held at Brandon Country Park on 22nd February, SUFFOC gained 3rd place and will be invited to the final in the autumn.

We had a fantastic turnout of 24 competitors across most of the classes.  The final scores were very close, as we were only 2 points behind second placed LOG.

The top 13 scores count towards the total, but even those whose scores didn’t count towards our total may have pushed other club scores down.

Particular congratulations to our 4 top scorers:

Ethan Radcliffe           100 points       class 9M

Emily Wightman          100 points       class 10W

Gareth Radcliffe         99 points         class 2

Robin Thomas            99 points         class 7

Full results are available https://suffoc.co.uk/results/2026/Brandon/index.html

Put the date of the final in your diary now.

Sunday 18th October, Pippingford Park, near East Grinstead.
